title: What is Ethical: AIHED Driving Humans or Human-Driven AIHED? A Conceptual Framework enabling the ‘Ethos’ of AI-driven Higher education
reasoning: The paper is focused on defining and establishing an ethical 'Ethos' for AI in higher education. It proposes the HD-AIHED framework to address moral foundations, secular ethics (accountability, transparency, fairness), and human-centric values, while extensively discussing the moral and emotional depth of education in the context of AI.
